words.example: The old man shared his wisdom about life.
words.exampleCn: 老人分享了他对人生的智慧。

words.cn: adj. 先进的; 高级的; 高等的
words.example: They use advanced computers in this lab.
words.exampleCn: 这个实验室使用先进的电脑。

words.example: The aeroplane flew above the clouds.
words.exampleCn: 飞机在云层之上飞行。

words.cn: adv. 之后; 后来; 以后
words.example: We had dinner and afterwards we watched a film.
words.exampleCn: 我们吃了晚饭,然后看了一部电影。

words.cn: n. 专辑; 音乐专辑
words.example: Her new album is very popular with young people.
words.exampleCn: 她的新专辑很受年轻人的欢迎。

words.example: The ambulance arrived quickly and saved the man.
words.exampleCn: 救护车很快到达,救了那个人。

words.example: He doesn't live here anymore.
words.exampleCn: 他已经不住在这里了。

words.cn: n. 阿拉伯语; adj. 阿拉伯的
words.example: She is learning Arabic at evening classes.
words.exampleCn: 她在上夜校学阿拉伯语。

words.example: Grandpa is reading a book in his armchair.
words.exampleCn: 爷爷正坐在扶手椅里看书。

words.cn: n. 箭; 箭号; 箭头
words.example: He shot an arrow and hit the target.
words.exampleCn: 他射出一支箭,击中了靶子。

words.cn: adj. 有吸引力的; 诱人的
words.example: The small town has attractive old streets.
words.exampleCn: 这座小镇有迷人的老街。

words.cn: adj. 令人惊叹的; 极好的
words.example: The view from the mountain was awesome.
words.exampleCn: 从山顶看到的景色令人惊叹。

words.cn: n. 烧烤; v. 烧烤
words.example: We had a barbecue in the garden on Sunday.
words.exampleCn: 我们周日 在花园里烤了肉。

words.example: My phone battery is dead. I need a charger.
words.exampleCn: 我手机没电了,需要充电。

words.example: This swimming class is for beginners.
words.exampleCn: 这个游泳班是给初学者的。

words.example: The beginning of the story was a little slow.
words.exampleCn: 故事的开头有点慢。

words.cn: v. 打赌; n. 赌金
words.example: I bet you five dollars that we'll win.
words.exampleCn: 我跟你赌五美元,我们会赢。

words.example: The school gave out a booklet about safety rules.
words.exampleCn: 学校发了一本关于安全规则的小册子。

words.example: There are fifty books on her bookshelf.
words.exampleCn: 她的书架上有五十本书。

words.example: We bought that novel at the bookshop downtown.
words.exampleCn: 我们在市中心的书店买了那本小说。

words.example: The ball bounced off the wall.
words.exampleCn: 球从墙上弹了回来。

words.example: She has been my girlfriend, not my boyfriend.
words.exampleCn: 她是我的女朋友,不是男朋友。

words.cn: n. 刹车; v. 刹(车)
words.example: He stepped on the brake to stop the car.
words.exampleCn: 他踩下刹车把车停下。

words.cn: adj. 杰出的; 很成功的
words.example: She gave a brilliant speech at school.
words.exampleCn: 她在学校做了一次精彩的演讲。

words.example: Grandma uses a broom to sweep the floor.
words.exampleCn: 奶奶用扫帚扫地。

words.example: She became a successful businesswoman at thirty.
words.exampleCn: 她三十岁就成了成功的女商人。

words.example: We met at a small cafe near the school.
words.exampleCn: 我们在学校附近的一家小咖啡馆见面。

words.example: We set up our tent at the campsite by the lake.
words.exampleCn: 我们在湖边的营地上搭了帐篷。

words.example: We went boating on the canal last weekend.
words.exampleCn: 上周末我们去运河划船了。

words.example: She has had a long career as a doctor.
words.exampleCn: 她做了很久的医生工作。

words.example: We found a small cave behind the trees.
words.exampleCn: 我们在树后面发现了一个小山洞。

words.cn: n. 手机; 移动电话
words.example: Don't use your cellphone while driving.
words.exampleCn: 开车时请不要使用手机。

words.example: He met some friends in an online chatroom.
words.exampleCn: 他在一个网络聊天室认识了一些朋友。

words.example: I'll have a cheeseburger and a Coke, please.
words.exampleCn: 我要一个芝士汉堡和一杯可乐。

words.example: She bought some medicine at the chemist on the corner.
words.exampleCn: 她在街角的药房买了一些药。
